_doc: Authoritative HCPCS/CPT constants that OVERRIDE the CMS Part B PUF descriptor when the PUF copy is wrong. The PUF HCPCS_Desc is a denormalized copy and has drifted for some codes (e.g. 99489 wrongly flipped 'each additional 30 minutes' -> '60 minutes' in 2021-2024, ~2x-ing any unit->time math). hcpcs_lookup.py cross-checks the PUF descriptor's parsed minutes against minutes_per_unit here; on conflict it uses the authoritative value and emits a hard warning. Source of truth = AMA CPT. Add codes here whenever a unit->time/$ conversion depends on a code's definition. Verified 2026-06-11.

99487.authoritative_descriptor: Complex chronic care management services, first 60 minutes of clinical staff time directed by a physician or other qualified health care professional, per calendar month

99489.authoritative_descriptor: Complex chronic care management services, each additional 30 minutes of clinical staff time directed by a physician or other qualified health care professional, per calendar month
99489.basis: AMA CPT (CMS PUF wrongly shows 60 min for 2021-2024)

99437.authoritative_descriptor: Chronic care management services, each additional 30 minutes provided personally by a physician or other qualified health care professional, per calendar month
